data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January (prior year comparative on the statement of financial position) is large, reflecting historical reinsurance-to-close activity noted in the report. The document does not provide a clear, single-line gross prior-year movement figure in the technical reserves notes that could be unambiguously extracted from the scanned pages; therefore a quantified prior-year development number could not be determined from the available images. The report cites uncertainty around the timing and settlement of claims and refers to reinsurance-to-close (RITC) activity as an influence on technical provisions.
raw_causal_phrases: uncertainty as to the occurrence, amount and timing of insurance liabilities
the impact on technical provisions is highlighted in note 4, the Statement of Financial Position 2017 comparative number
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages are scanned images with rotation and partial legibility. I located a large 'Claims outstanding' gross figure in the Technical Provisions / Insurance Liabilities table (interpreted as GBP'000) and converted to millions (1561.969). However, the detailed 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (gross) was not clearly legible or not presented as a single gross movement figure on the pages available; the claims development triangle and movement notes are present but illegible in the images provided. Where numbers were uncertain I left fields null rather than risk misreporting. The gross premiums total 945,963 (GBP'000) was located but the detailed regulatory segmental breakdown text was not reliably readable for exact verbatim class names/amounts, so gross_premium_mix is omitted. The report also references a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) which distorts comparatives; this may make triangle-based PYD calculations unreliable.
